hypothesis: The default locking provider is in-memory, so the acquireLockStep on the cart id in completeCartWorkflow only serializes calls within one Medusa process. Two servers sharing one database completing the same cart at the same moment can both pass the order_cart idempotency lookup before either links an order, so two orders may be created for one cart. I expect one_order_per_cart to fail, and possibly no_oversell if both orders reserve the single SOLO unit.

hypothesis: Two different carts each hold a line for OVS-PIECE (WIDGET, seeded stock 10) and OVS-TWOPACK (2 WIDGET units per unit). If the stock check is done per line, a cart with qty that fits alone can pass while the combined needs of several carts or several lines on one shared inventory item exceed stock. I expect the combined WIDGET need to exceed 10 in some runs, producing an oversold order set. Setting WIDGET stock to 3 makes the window easier to hit.

hypothesis: Carts are prepared against SOLO stock 1, then stock is changed to 5 before the race, and several distinct carts for OVS-SOLO complete concurrently. If the reserved_quantity counter is updated from a value read earlier, concurrent reservations can lose an increment so reserved_quantity differs from the sum of live reservation rows. I expect reserved_matches_reservations to fail if the counter is written stale, and no_oversell may be exercised as well.
